span.p:
Read replica
report ne DB ghera
-> copy primary ka log (WAL) padh ke peeche chalti, 1-2 sec purani
bhaari report copy pe, primary sirf payment ke liye
(read replica)
pay kiya, balance dekha -> primary se, copy 1-2 sec peeche
copy aur peeche -> naapo, alert (replication lag)
